requirements.text: A Petri Net model has the concept of  places
a Petri Net has the concept of Transitions
a Petri Net has the concept of Network (Net)
in a Petri Net a Pace maps to a single Net
In a Petri Net a Place may be the destination of a Transition
a Transition maps to a single Network
in a Petri Net a Transition must have a destination, and that destination must by a Place.
in a Petri Net a Network may be composed of any number of Places.
